online form to book appointments is excellent, and they always seem to call really soon after you fill it out (like within an hour) to schedule an appointment - often the appointment is even the same day. Amazingly fast appointments, and the GPs are great.

My one complaint is that every appointment I've had has been with a different GP, so I have to keep re-explaining my health issues. This is despite me using the "request a specific GP" part of the form, in which I normally request whoever I had an appointment with last. Personally, I would be happy to wait a few days to see the same GP every time rather than have immediate appointments with random GPs, but can't complain too much as the appointments really are so efficient.
